basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.details: The notice does not mention any experience requirement for the Medical Officer post. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only by email. The application must be sent on or before 1 December 2026.

Fill in the application in the format given as Annexure-I (Part-A: brief particulars; Part-B: educational qualifications, other qualifications, past employment, present occupation, training programmes, two referees, list of enclosures and the declaration).
Paste a recent passport size photograph on the right top corner of Annexure-I.
Attach your bio-data, testimonials and self-certified photocopies of all supporting documents.
Write the subject line exactly as: "Application against Advt. No.31 /2026 for the post of Medical Officers (on Contract)".

In the referees section of the form, both referees must not be related to the applicant, and an employed applicant must name the employer as one referee. A list of publications, if any, may be attached as an annexure.
important_instructions: The University reserves the right to shortlist candidates for the selection process if a large number of applications is received. The shortlisting criteria shall be decided by the University and shall be final and binding. The University reserves the right to fill the post or otherwise. The joining time stated by the applicant in the form may not be considered as binding.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice does not mention any experience requirement for the Medical Officer post. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay/Emoluments: Rs. 80,000.00 per month (fixed). Appointment to the post will be purely on contract basis. The engagement will be contractual for a period of eleven (11) months, with the provision for renewal subject to satisfactory performance. The engagement will not provide any right to claim future absorption in the University in any capacity.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Tezpur University Medical Officers (On Contract)
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only by email. The application must be sent on or before 1 December 2026 . Fill in the application in the format given as Annexure-I (Part-A: brief particulars; Part-B: educational qualifications, other qualifications, past employment, present occupation, training programmes, two referees, list of enclosures and the declaration). Paste a recent passport size photograph on the right top corner of Annexure-I. Attach your bio-data, testimonials and self-certified photocopies of all supporting documents. Email the application to [email protected] . Write the subject line exactly as: "Application against Advt. No.31 /2026 for the post of Medical Officers (on Contract)". In the referees section of the form, both referees must not be related to the applicant, and an employed applicant must name the employer as one referee. A list of publications, if any, may be attached as an annexure.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Filled in application as per Annexure-I Recent passport size photograph pasted on the right top corner of Annexure-I Bio-data Testimonials Self-certified photocopies of all supporting documents

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The University reserves the right to shortlist candidates for the selection process if a large number of applications is received. The shortlisting criteria shall be decided by the University and shall be final and binding. The University reserves the right to fill the post or otherwise. The joining time stated by the applicant in the form may not be considered as binding.

faq.question: Q1. How many Medical Officer vacancies has Tezpur University announced?
faq.answer: Tezpur University has announced Two (02) Medical Officer posts on contract basis under Advertisement No. 31/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Tezpur University Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the filled in application by email is 1 December 2026 (01.12.2026).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Tezpur University Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification printed in the advertisement is an MBBS Degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Tezpur University Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The advertisement states the maximum age as "No Bar".

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Tezpur University Medical Officer on contract?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 80,000.00 per month (fixed).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Tezpur University Medical Officer recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email the filled in Annexure-I with a pasted passport size photograph, bio-data, testimonials and self-certified photocopies of all supporting documents to [email protected] on or before 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What subject line should the application email have?
faq.answer: The subject line must be "Application against Advt. No.31 /2026 for the post of Medical Officers (on Contract)".

faq.question: Q8. Is the Tezpur University Medical Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely on contract basis for eleven (11) months, with provision for renewal subject to satisfactory performance, and gives no right to claim future absorption in the University.

faq.question: Q9. Will all applicants be called for selection?
faq.answer: The University reserves the right to shortlist candidates if a large number of applications is received, and the shortlisting criteria decided by the University shall be final and binding.
